scope: Bounded independent code review and local synthetic controls of canonical prediction preparation, source/challenger seal integration, released metric worker scope, exact four-view dimer aggregation and saved correspondence replay.

resolvedFindings.finding: A subset of the final reserved challenger model roster could be supplied.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Reserved preflight now requires exact distinct frozen model bindings; omission, addition and duplicated supplied models are rejected. Source-only selection keeps both rosters empty.

resolvedFindings.finding: A rehashed failed/interrupted inventory could alter the failure explanation or include stray geometry-integrity metadata.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Outcome preflight compares the explanation to the authenticated generation receipt and requires absent rawInputIntegrity. Preparation and feature hashes remain unchanged; altered failure metadata cannot reach outcome sealing.

checks: All planned generated/failed/interrupted attempts remain in preparation and outcome membership.
Canonicalization binds exact full input sequences, receptor order, fixed selected Nb and context; wrong equivalent-Nb role and rehashed map changes are rejected.
Source and optional challenger ranks replay from bound prediction-only features/models before any outcome seal.
Both development and reserved workers require a release bound to the sealed cohort/rankings; snapshots are rejected.
Reserved final policy precedes generation and authenticates exact accepted enrollment sequences/roles and model roster.
Dimer metric uses all four fixed native assignments with unchanged prediction Nb; any unavailable view prevents a favorable partial maximum.
Explicit mmCIF dispatch changes only the two pinned loaders; synthetic independent NumPy checks and residue-segment correspondence replay passed.
No new production prediction/native comparison was performed in this review.
limitations: Saved outcome verification replays provenance, correspondences and aggregation; it does not independently recompute DockQ for production poses.
Preparation alone remains the frozen earlier contract; failure-description authenticity is enforced by the outcome preflight gate.
